human-fragments-motion.label: Motion Step
human-fragments-motion.prompt: Create a 9:16 editorial typography poster from a single human-centered lifestyle moment. Use oversized typography as the main composition structure; let the person, movement, city space or everyday scene appear inside letters, pass through them or break beyond their edges. Theme and title: ${title}. Subject: ${subject}; possible directions include Asian or Western, male or female. Human state: ${human_state}; consider movement, walking, daily life or body rhythm. Scene: ${scene}. Color palette: ${color_palette}. Supporting line: ${supporting_line}. Series: HUMAN FRAGMENTS. Year: 2026. Direction: ${direction}; choose MOTION STEP, CITY TRACE, CRUISE MEMORY or PULSE FORM. Keep the layout minimal with the chosen title, “HUMAN FRAGMENTS,” the chosen supporting line and “2026.” Use realistic photography, natural skin and hair, subtle paper grain, strong negative space and clean editorial composition. Avoid dense text, barcodes, fake brands, logos, URLs, watermarks, plastic skin and generic poster templates.

human-fragments-sport.label: Kinetic Field
human-fragments-sport.prompt: Create a 9:16 editorial poster in the HUMAN FRAGMENTS visual system. Theme: ${theme}; suggested themes are football, badminton, jump rope or floral design. Subject: ${subject}, including age, gender and appearance. Outfit: ${outfit}. Action: ${action}. Scene: ${scene}. Two-word title: ${title}. Short supporting line: ${supporting_line}. Year: 2026. Use oversized cropped typography as the main structure, with letters acting as windows into the sky, court, buildings, flowers, studio or ground. Keep the main person complete in front of the typography; do not cut through the face, torso, thighs or other important body parts. Let one action element break beyond the letters, such as a football and shoe, racket and shuttlecock, jump-rope arc, or bouquet and hands. Use realistic photography, natural skin, believable anatomy, strong foreground perspective, subtle paper grain, a warm off-white background, restrained colors and clean editorial spacing. Keep text minimal: use the chosen title and supporting line with HUMAN FRAGMENTS and 2026.

laundromat-dance.label: Laundromat Dance
laundromat-dance.prompt: Theme: Laundromat K-pop Dance. Character: ${character_description}. Outfit: ${outfit}. Scene details: ${scene_details}. Choreography: ${choreography}. Suggested defaults are a young adult East Asian K-pop dancer with a realistic face; a pink cardigan worn off one shoulder, white cropped tank top, light-blue denim pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers and white headphones; spinning washing machines, a folding table, a laundry basket and soft indoor light; and waiting pose / music starts / step-in / bright idol pose / side groove / hair-flip turn / spin combo / customer enters / shy glance / recover beat / full spin + kick / jump accent / low pose / cardigan sweep / walk-in twirl / breathing ending. Keep it as one continuous dance take in a clean bright laundromat with a real-life everyday mood. The customer glances only once and keeps walking. The dancer feels briefly shy but keeps dancing. Avoid fixed camera, random cuts, face drift, outfit changes, plastic skin and background characters stealing focus.

underwater-editorial.label: Underwater Editorial
underwater-editorial.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical underwater fashion editorial poster. Subject: ${subject}, describing an adult woman, her appearance and hairstyle. Dress: ${dress}, including color, material, sculptural silhouette and exposed shoulders, back, waist or leg. Handheld object: ${handheld_object}; possibilities include a flower, glass slipper, mirror, transparent mask or perfume bottle. Pose and expression: ${pose_and_expression}, including body direction, hand gesture, gaze and emotion. Main title: ${main_title}. Small tagline: ${tagline}. Color palette: ${color_palette}, balancing water, dress and accent colors. Show the woman floating naturally beneath a clearly visible water surface with realistic ripples, refraction, caustic highlights and a distorted partial reflection. Keep the body silhouette visible; hair, dress, ribbons, bubbles and object follow one current direction with believable underwater physics. Use cinematic blue light beams, realistic skin, fine wet hair, irregular bubbles and particles. Integrate the oversized high-contrast serif title partly behind the body, dress or object with subtle refraction, translucent layers and displaced reflections. Strong negative space, refined editorial hierarchy and no plastic CGI skin.

wuxia-swordswoman.label: Wuxia Swordswoman
wuxia-swordswoman.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical, realistic cinematic character portrait and visual-development image of a young East Asian swordswoman. She has a cool, restrained presence, naturally appealing features, realistic skin, a tall slender figure and long half-tied hair with loose flyaways. Dress her in a moon-white lightweight inner layer, a translucent ice-blue or pale smoky-teal outer robe, a blue-gray sash and long fabric ties, with airy translucent fabrics and rich layering. Give her a complete, clearly visible, elegantly proportioned cold-silver Chinese longsword with a simple hilt and short teal tassel. Set the scene in a misty bamboo forest at dawn, graded in deep teal and cool gray-blue with fog, volumetric light and soft side backlighting. Shoot from a low angle with her full body in frame while she performs ${action}; suggested actions are stepping onto bamboo, sweeping across the grove, raising the sword in midair or landing and sheathing the blade. Add a translucent ice-blue fabric tie close to the lens, enlarged by foreground perspective and slightly defocused. Keep the figure, fabric ties, hair and sleeves moving in one wind direction. The pose should feel light, elegant and physically coherent, with clear legs and believable weight. Real cinematic still quality; avoid illustration, game art, heavy theatrical costume, excessive gold jewelry, plastic skin and overdone CGI.

literary-art-poster.label: Literary Monument
literary-art-poster.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical contemporary literary art poster. Source quote: ${quote}. Author: ${author}. Work title: ${work_title}. Publication date: ${publication_date}. Main title: ${main_title}. Accent color: ${accent_color}. Translate the chosen quote into one monumental dark object, a tiny human figure, subtle low-relief embossing and large areas of warm ivory negative space. Use the exact chosen main title in oversized refined serif typography, and include the exact quote, author, work title and date as small accurate English text. Use tactile handmade paper, restrained lighting and only the chosen subtle accent color. The main object should feel heavy and sculptural, while pale embossed background details become visible only up close. Keep the composition minimal, asymmetrical and editorial. Avoid literal illustration, vintage book design, fantasy effects, crowded typography, cheap 3D and generic quote-poster aesthetics.

tuscan-residence.label: Tuscan Residence
tuscan-residence.prompt: Create a four-page interior design proposal series. Project title: ${project_title}. Space type: ${space_type}. Material and color palette: ${material_palette}. Suggested defaults are Sunlit Tuscan Residence; a contemporary Tuscan living room for a real private home; and lime plaster, travertine, dark walnut, natural linen, aged leather, blackened iron, handmade ceramics, terracotta and olive green. Make the space sun-washed, warm, architectural, earthy and refined, with large arched openings and soft afternoon light. Use a professional editorial identity with warm limestone-gray backgrounds, terracotta page-number blocks, dark olive rules, elegant serif titles, clean sans-serif labels and restrained handwritten notes across four vertical 4:5 boards. 01 / Spatial Concept: panoramic room plus concise materials, palette and key pieces. 02 / Architecture & Living Flow: axonometric breakdown, floor plan, sun path and circulation. 03 / Furniture & Collected Objects: asymmetric curated selection. 04 / Material, Light & Atmosphere: close-up panels, swatches and color balance. Avoid farmhouse, rustic inn, vacation rental, coastal décor, distressed wood, vintage clutter, all-beige minimalism, logos, famous replicas and long paragraphs.

summer-hillside.label: Summer Hillside
summer-hillside.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical realistic summer portrait. Subject: ${subject}. Action: ${action}. Scene: ${scene}. Outfit: ${outfit}. Handheld object: ${handheld_object}. Let hair and clothing move naturally in the wind while seeds drift into the sky. Place the camera almost at grass level and shoot strongly upward from the side as the subject passes, preserving a wide blue sky, natural body movement and slightly imperfect candid composition. The subject has only two arms and two hands: one holds the chosen object while the other moves naturally. Use a clean direct iPhone-photo feeling, natural skin texture, minimal retouching, vivid grass and fresh summer colors. Avoid polished commercial photography, plastic skin, AI-perfect faces, excessive blur, overexposure and staged poses.

doodle-shadow.label: Doodle Shadow
doodle-shadow.prompt: Use the uploaded character reference as a strict identity and wardrobe guide. Preserve facial features and proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle and color, visible accessories and outfit design. Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing both a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character and a black hand-drawn doodle shadow of the same character directly on the wall. The person and doodle share ${pose_style}; a playful or silly pose is a good starting point. Keep the person natural, realistic and photogenic with ${facial_expression}; suggested expressions include cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed or playful. Make the doodle shadow a more exaggerated, chaotic cartoon version. Use black linework only for the shadow; it must not look like a second realistic person, an ordinary physical shadow or a full-color anime character. Match the character through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, clothing outline and pose. Add motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles or comic symbols. Invent a fresh funny pose each time and avoid repeatedly using pointing, finger guns or the same standing pose. Cute, fashionable, humorous and social-media ready.
